# srezai — web access for AI agents

13 tools over MCP at https://srezai.ru/api/mcp; the same tools via CLI `srezai`
(npm package `srezai-cli`, zero dependencies) and REST base https://srezai.ru.
Runet-first coverage, PDF, screenshots, site crawls, schema extraction, claim
verification with quotes, synthesized answers and deep research.

## Skills (6 narrow skills, Apache-2.0)

```bash
npx skills add srezai-team/srezai-web-search-pro-skill
```

- srezai-web: веб-доступ для агентов: точка входа
- srezai-search: найти ссылки, факты и картинки
- srezai-read: прочитать страницу, вытащить поля, увидеть вёрстку
- srezai-site: карта сайта и обход раздела
- srezai-research: проверить факт, собрать ответ, исследовать тему
- srezai-transcript: субтитры и текст видео YouTube

## Tools

- web_search: Search the web: links, facts, snippets. Price: 1 credit per call.
- image_search: Find images and direct file URLs. Price: 1 credit per call.
- read_url: Read the text of a page whose URL you already have. Price: 1 credit per call.
- read_urls: Read several known pages in one batch. Price: 1 credit per link.
- extract: Pull a few specific values off a page with a JSON schema. Price: 2 credits per link.
- fetch_page: See the layout, typography or a broken page as a screenshot. Price: 3 credits; 1 if the browser could not render the page.
- map: Map a site: sections, URLs, how large it is. Price: 1 credit per 10 URLs returned, minimum 1.
- crawl: Walk a section of a site and read its pages. Price: map + 1 credit per page read.
- verify_claim: Check one claim and get a verdict with verbatim quotes. Price: 8 credits per call.
- answer_search: Get one synthesized answer across several sources. Price: 3 (fast) / 5 (balanced) / 10 (deep) credits.
- deep_research: Run multi-step research and get a finished answer with sources. Price: 20 credits + 3 per 1000 output tokens.
- yt_srt: YouTube video text: transcripts, summaries, quotes. Price: 1 credit per video; 15 with speaker labeling.
- get_usage: Check balance, remaining quota, spend and the price list. Price: free; does not use the quota.

Generated from src/tools.json v0.5.0.
